title: Rust: Pub/Sub Message Broker
description: Build a publish/subscribe message broker that manages topics, subscribers, and message routing.

steps.title: Topic Manager
steps.description: Create a `Broker` struct that maintains a `HashMap<String, Vec<Sender<String>>>` mapping topic names to subscriber lists. Implement `create_topic` and `subscribe` methods.
hints: `subscribe` adds a sender to the topic's subscriber list.

verification.failureMessage: Create a topic and subscribe to it.

steps.title: Message Publishing
steps.description: Implement a `publish` method that sends a message to all subscribers of a given topic. Each subscriber receives the message via their channel.
hints: Iterate over the subscriber list for the topic.

verification.failureMessage: Publish a message to a topic and print confirmation.

steps.title: Wildcard Subscriptions
steps.description: Support wildcard topic patterns: `sports.*` matches `sports.football` and `sports.tennis`. Store patterns alongside exact topic names and match against published topics.
hints: Store `(String, Vec<Sender>)` where String can be a pattern.
Check if topic matches pattern using `starts_with` or glob matching.

verification.failureMessage: Subscribe with a wildcard pattern and match a topic.

steps.title: Message Filtering
steps.description: Add message filtering: subscribers can provide a filter function that determines which messages to receive. Implement as a `filter: fn(&str) -> bool` stored alongside the sender.
hints: Wrap `Sender` in a struct with a filter closure.
Use `Box<dyn Fn(&str) -> bool>` for the filter type.
Only forward messages that pass the filter.

verification.failureMessage: Apply a filter that blocks certain messages and print results.

steps.title: Full Broker Simulation
steps.description: Combine all features: create a broker with topics, subscribe multiple clients (some with wildcards, some with filters), publish messages to various topics, and verify delivery. Print all deliveries.
hints: Publish 4 messages and show which clients received each.

verification.failureMessage: Simulate a complete pub/sub scenario and print deliveries.
